reply.emotion: warm and friendly, feeling a sudden spark of happiness
notes: sonreír is an stem-changing verb (e > í) and requires a written accent on the í in most conjugated forms, like sonrío and sonrió.
Do not confuse sonreír (to smile) with reír (to laugh). You can sonreír without making any sound.

senses.definition: Hacer un gesto con la boca para mostrar alegría o felicidad.

examples.text: Ella empezó a sonreír al ver a su amigo.
examples.translation: She began to smile when she saw her friend.
examples.emotion: sweet and tender, remembering a dear friend

senses.definition: Mostrar afecto, aprobación o buena disposición ante algo.

examples.text: La suerte parece sonreír al equipo este año.
examples.translation: Luck seems to smile on the team this year.
examples.emotion: hopeful and optimistic about the future
